form.title: TCRtoolkit Single-Cell Analysis (VDJ-only)
form.description: Runs the single-cell TCR pipeline without a GEX/Seurat object: pseudobulks each sample's VDJ contigs into a clonotype table and analyzes it through the shared bulk-TCR engine (sample/patient/compare). Provide a samplesheet with 'sample' and 'path' columns (path pointing to each sample's Cell Ranger VDJ outs/ directory), plus optional 'patient_id', 'condition', and 'timepoint' metadata columns.

project_name.description: Name used to label outputs and reports for this run.
project_name.title: Project name

pseudobulk_qc_min_clones.description: Minimum number of clones a pseudobulked sample must have to pass the QC gate.
pseudobulk_qc_min_clones.title: Pseudobulk QC: min clones

pseudobulk_qc_min_cells.description: Minimum number of cells a pseudobulked sample must have to pass the QC gate.
pseudobulk_qc_min_cells.title: Pseudobulk QC: min cells

pseudobulk_qc_mode.description: 'drop' skips samples that fail the QC gate; 'hard_stop' aborts the whole run if any sample fails.
pseudobulk_qc_mode.title: Pseudobulk QC mode
